title: Round 12 / algorithm inventor A
question: Lifted-relation algorithms: invent ECDLP algorithms that use the integer structure of coordinates in [0,p) (small lifts to Z, integer smoothness, lattice reduction / LLL on relations among lifted multiples, carries) to find relations a*P + b*Q = O faster than collisions; prototype and benchmark against Pollard rho.

claims: A1 (Farey-height factor base, MITM index calculus, l=2/l=3 and m=3 control) recovers k on 66/66 (50/50 for m=3) toy instances, 12..24 bits, but is slower than DP rho at every size (U1 ratio 42.7x and 28.9x at 24 bits; pre-registered verdict NO-ADVANTAGE; experimental, tested domain only).
Structural cost bound for hash-based index calculus: U1 >~ sqrt(p*s) > sqrt(p) with s unknown logs; measured U1/sqrt(p s) = 4-8 at 18-24 bits (heuristic model, experimental).
A2 (Veronese-tensor LLL decomposition of a target as two Farey points) failed: LLL success 0 of 124/77/61 existing decompositions at 16/20/24 bits; not viable (experimental).
A3 (lift to E(Q), y^2=x^3-2): correct on planted instances (50/50) but random-instance success 0/300 at 12..24 bits, coverage 1e-3..4e-7 (Miller coverage, experimental).
No speedup over Pollard rho is claimed or observed; HYP-2de84d42 status unchanged.
next_action: PI review of round-12 inventor A: all three candidates negative. Only remaining lever in this territory is a non-generic relation finder cheaper than a sqrt(p*s) birthday search on a lifted/structured factor base; test per-relation solver exponent at m>=3 (Groebner/resultant) on Farey/PKM bases, or CM-orbit structure. No commits made.
